answer: Price every seat with a refundable deposit worth more than any one identity could steal, and extra identities stop paying off. An honest agent posts a single stake and draws it back whole, a small oasis of locked value returned intact. A farmer must bond each clone on its own, and one caught cheat forfeits a deposit harder to crack than a walnut; since the slash outweighs the skim, each added head pushes profit past the horizon where it can never be recovered. Copies cost more to keep alive than they can ever earn back.
